name: visionclaw-agent
description: VisionClaw Agent — a multi-tenant agentic AI platform plugin that connects OpenAI Codex CLI to a configured VisionClaw instance over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex CLI to a configured VisionClaw MCP server.
interface.longDescription: VisionClaw Agent is a multi-tenant agentic platform. This proprietary connection plugin connects OpenAI Codex CLI to a running VisionClaw instance over MCP. Available personas, tools, and capabilities depend on the connected instance and its tenant-scoped MCP key.
defaultPrompt: Use VisionClaw to delegate this task to the right specialist persona.
Use VisionClaw to search my organisation's knowledge base for relevant prior decisions.
Use VisionClaw to schedule a recurring weekday-morning briefing.
